title: The Oct. 7 Attack Changed Israel, but Not Its Politics
summary: As Israelis prepare to vote for the first time since the Hamas-led assault, they remain divided over whether to hold Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu responsible for negligence or fault the “treason” of his generals.
